notes: What the directory object needs from the room service (realtime-rooms interfaces/room-session.json). The runtime direction is rooms calling the directory (POST and DELETE below, defined by interfaces/room-directory.json); the only call the directory makes is the one to ask a room it has not heard from.

arguments: x-code-version header: the current deploy version
GET https://room/room.returns: RoomEntry {id,status,playerCount,names,code?}; asked once for each id in roomIds that has no entry yet, through env.ROOM.getByName(id)

calledBy.POST https://directory/: a room posts its RoomEntry when its players or status change
